files.README.md:
# claimdesk-api workspace

claimdesk-api takes insurance claims from brokers and the web portal and drives them through
intake, document storage, scoring, rendering and payout.

logs/claimdesk-api.log is the service application log for 2025-11-04 (daily rotation).
One record per line:

    <timestamp> <level> [service] module=<component> msg=<event> <key=value ...>

The module field names the internal component that emitted the record. Levels use the usual
INFO / WARN / ERROR / FATAL ladder; a FATAL record means the emitting component stopped and
the service supervisor has to be paged.
files.docs/runbook.md:
# claimdesk on-call runbook

- Dashboards: Grafana folder "claimdesk" (intake rate, render queue depth, ledger lag).
- Escalation: claims-platform rota, PagerDuty service "claimdesk-primary".
- A FATAL record is a page: the component named on that record has stopped.
- The nightly document reindex runs at 01:30 local from the archive worker, not from this service.

turns.prompt: ClaimDesk's API writes one plain-text application log per day at logs/claimdesk-api.log. Yesterday a single entry reached FATAL level. For the reliability review, report the module that emitted that FATAL entry. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
